scope: First installs use the full installed-app base Dock; upgrades append missing installed base apps once, preserving current pins and order, including when layout reset is disabled. Later reinstalls preserve removals. No missing applications are installed.

checks.environment: Host Python 3.14, isolated QJSEngine; no live desktop or DBus calls
checks.limit: Does not prove live installer or compositor behavior; cache write warning only.
Content-bound dependency rule requires fresh Dock images; every later runtime edit invalidates the scoped rule.

checks.command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_edition_transition.py tests/test_multilanguage.py tests/test_release_screenshots.py -k 'edition or language or console_maintenance or dock_migration'
checks.reason: Resolve CI legacy-panel fixture and missing translation failures; regression fixture also works with shallow CI checkouts.

visual_scope.retained_provenance: Original source commits, versions, hashes and approvals are retained in release-capture.json. No retained image is claimed as a new capture.
visual_scope.result: Four fresh Dock frames captured sequentially and visually reviewed; 102 unrelated reviewed frames retained.
visual_scope.limits: Fresh installation and light/dark Dock appearance on pinned KDE neon VM; upgrade pin merging and one-time persistence exercised by focused QJSEngine tests. No new unrelated desktop, wizard, boot or shutdown captures.

release_gate: Successful test.yml push runs for the exact release commits on dev and main in both repositories; provenance verified by release.yml. See GitHub Actions on the tagged commits.
